release_notes:
# Store Dates 1.0.1

## Release inputs

- Version: `1.0.1`
- Minimum supported version: `1.0.0`
- Update mode: automatic
- Requires migrations: no
- Critical: no

## Bakery

Bakery keeps the quick date guide for staff: choose, type, or scan a product and see its Days to Give and sell by date. The Bakery area remains the staff-facing daily workflow.

## Dairy permissions

Dairy is manager-only. Managers can create and review Dairy weeks, enter quantities, and view order recommendations. Staff cannot open Dairy, including by typing its address directly.

## One-week mapped CSV import

Managers can import one Dairy week at a time. Map the CSV columns, review the preview, and confirm the result before it changes the week. This keeps a spreadsheet import narrow and reviewable instead of creating a new inventory system.

## Product lists

Bakery and Dairy have separate product lists so each workflow shows only the products it needs. When an imported Dairy row has no usable barcode, the manager must explicitly confirm that it is a no-UPC product before continuing.

## CSV and draft cleanup

Uploaded CSV files and temporary import drafts are deleted after a completed import, cancellation, or expiry. Do not rely on an uploaded file as a record after the import has been reviewed.

## Viable Food Systems branding

Store Dates continues to use the approved Viable Food Systems visual language, including the supplied first-party logo treatment and restrained forest, terra, and cream palette. See `docs/BRAND-ASSETS.md` for brand-asset provenance.

## Update preparation and recovery

Before the first automatic update, make recoverable backups of the database, `.env`, and application files. Confirm that update-key configuration is ready without displaying any private value. After the update, confirm version `1.0.1`, normal sign-in, and no pending updater recovery state. If finalization fails, restore only the backup tied to that pending update or use the tested manual cPanel package; database migrations are not automatically rolled back.
